_note: What a creature leaves behind, by canonical name and in per-mille. The order matters: it is the order the stream is drawn in, so a seeded walk replays only while it holds. The rates are not the same because the pit does not deal its three creatures the same: `draw_enemy` weights a pool so its hardest member is its rarest, and in The End of All Gears that is eighty encounters in ninety-seven for an A. Rat, sixteen for a toad and ONE for a Wallspider Swarm. So the rate has to carry what the draw does not, and `a_set_is_a_few_hours_and_not_a_lifetime` measures what a player actually counts — wins in the region that holds the creature, drawn with the real weighting. Even at the ceiling the Wallspider Weave is the far end of the band; the pool weight is what would fix that properly and that is the human's call. See PLAN.md 6a.
